title: Friday Quick Tip
subtitle: Set expectations before the first game
hook: What do your team's parents think the season is for?
intro: Three parents have three different ideas of what the season is for.
statement: Parents follow the plan they were told.
q1: Do you hold a short parent meeting before day one —
q2: or send one clear note and keep it simple?
q3: What do parents need to hear from you first?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But seasons go smoother
t2: when parents hear your plan before the first game.
cta: Coaches — how do you start with parents?
ctaLines: Ten minutes. Playing time. How to reach you.
ctaPrompt: Share your parent habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What do your team's parents think the season is for?
The first game ends. Three parents have three different ideas of what the season is for.
Parents follow the plan they were told.
A short meeting or one clear note. There is no perfect answer.
How do you start with parents? Share your habit in the comments.
